text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost. [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack players until their turn ends.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] This Digimon gains ＜Reboot＞ and ＜Blocker＞ until your opponent's turn ends.
